questions.question: At the dedication of the temple, what did King Solomon do as he stood before the altar with his hands spread toward heaven?

answers.text: He sang a song of David

questions.question: In his temple prayer, King Solomon spoke of God's promise to his father David. What did God promise about the throne of Israel?

answers.text: David would always have a man on it
It would move to a bigger city
Solomon would sit on it forever

questions.question: In his temple prayer, King Solomon spoke of a foreigner from far away who prays toward the temple. What did he ask God to do?

answers.text: Send him back to his own land
Make him go through a priest

questions.question: In King Solomon's temple prayer, Israel sins and God becomes angry with them. What did Solomon picture happening to them?

answers.text: An enemy takes them captive to his land
The temple falls down to the ground
Their king is driven from the throne
